scope: Read-only reconciliation of pending-artifact ownership, session boundaries, App guards, native inspection, exact fixture/workspace state, and focused tests

findings.nativeOwnership: Native inspection scans the selected project directory as project-pending and the root workspace index as workspace-index-pending; project-envelope identity is checked for project-pending artifacts and no transport/schema change is justified.
findings.appEntryGuard: The broken-reference route currently matches project-pending by kind only, so the exact target-project ownership boundary is not expressed in the UI predicate.
findings.appTerminalGuard: The broken-reference terminal reread currently requires pendingArtifacts.length === 0, which would reject preserved global workspace or unrelated-project evidence even after the target operation is complete.
findings.sessionBoundary: Self-test mode intentionally unloads the generic project proposal session; target session storage must remain MISSING before preview and unrelated stored sessions/evidence must not be cleared or replaced.
findings.smallestCorrection: Add a pure typed helper that recognizes only project-pending paths under projects/<exact target slug>/, use it in both broken-reference entry and terminal guards, and retain the complete pendingArtifacts array for display/diagnostics.
findings.requiredCoverage: Target-owned project pending blocks; unrelated project pending, workspace-index pending, near-prefix paths, and empty state do not; both entry and terminal guards use the helper.

nextBoundary.scope: Code-only add and use exact target-project pending-artifact ownership filtering in the broken-reference UI route, with focused pure/static tests.
